metadata.description: Bruno Seco's personal marketplace of Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: otel-signoz
plugins.description: Discovers backend services (APIs, an Auth server, workers/queues/background jobs) and frontends in any language or framework, instruments OpenTelemetry -> SigNoz traces/logs/metrics, and closes the Trace ID loop from backend errors to the frontend error screen. Ships a deeply validated .NET + Angular reference implementation.
